_about: Meme captions by situation (companion/images/memes.py): [top, bottom, mood]. "choice" pairs go on the two-panel "this, not that" format: [the one turned down, the one picked]. Each mood names faces for a picture of the companion and scenes for a picture of something else, both for an image model. In a world that runs in a past year (Back when, companion/world/decades.py), "since" leaves out a caption that names something from after that year ([pattern, first year], case-insensitive), and "decades" adds that decade's own captions to "anytime".
